_README: THE LEDGER — the single source of truth for every fact this project quotes.
Rule: prose cites the ledger; the ledger never cites prose. If a number, a status
label, or a constant appears in a Markdown file, it must agree with this file, and
tools/ledger_check.py enforces that. This exists because the project has already
shipped four different assertion counts across five documents.
Fields marked GENERATED are derived from docs/TEST_OUTPUT.txt by tools/ledger_sync.py.
Never hand-edit them; re-run the sync after capturing a test run.
Everything else is hand-maintained and should change only via a DECISIONS.md entry.

tests._GENERATED: by tools/ledger_sync.py from docs/TEST_OUTPUT.txt — do not hand-edit

determinism._note: interpreters_swept must cover interpreters_required or the claim is scoped down to what was swept. RAISED to five versions on 2026-07-25 (D-010). SEPARATELY, D-012 records that seed-sweeping ALONE cannot establish determinism for this substrate: iteration order derives from uuid4 values, which differ per process regardless of PYTHONHASHSEED. Determinism must be established by REMOVING order dependence, not by sweeping an axis that does not control it.

0a.name: substrate store
0a.note: RESTORED 2026-07-25 (D-016) after 0c. Determinism is now structural — no order dependence to perturb — not sampled. Verified across five CPython versions.

0b.name: spreading activation
0b.note: RESTORED 2026-07-25 (D-016) after 0c. The flow accumulator is retained naive and PROVED structurally single-term rather than converted; that bound is registered.

0b1.name: coalition strength determinism fix
0b1.note: Property claim held and holds. Its ENUMERATION was incomplete — a third Coalition construction site in nous_workspace.py was missed; corrected in place. Labels track properties, not report quality (D-016).

0b2.name: conserved activation (overlay, default-off)
0b2.note: overlay landed default-off; tester verdict FAIL — 7 of 9 invariants hold. DEFECT-B (N-5) and DEFECT-C (N-7) are the overlay's own and are OPEN. See D-011, D-012.

0c.name: deterministic road ordering + fsum
0c.note: Tester PASS 18/18. Restores Phase 0. Does NOT close the order-dependent-aggregate class — see 0d.

0d.name: order-dependent-aggregate detector + registry
0d.note: Detector first, not a fifth patch. Three prior encounters of this shape were all found by looking, never by a sweep.

2c.name: interoception
2c.note: mechanism tester-PASS; timing-pair meaning yardstick NOT-YET

0c-ii.name: boundary finiteness completion (floor)
0c-ii.note: floor=NaN SILENTLY disables the locality guard (3 nodes reached vs 6, no error, identical to floor=-inf), changing coalition membership and the competition. Same class as O-12 and DEFECT-C. decay_per_hop is deliberately NOT validated: it refuses loudly, and silence is the discriminator. D-016.
